status: Form-specific research, internal editorial corrections and content/dictionary/audio/preservation/browser/build/production offline checks passed; native review pending.
method: Original formal notices and ordinary spoken discussion. Explanations checked against first-party grammar publishers and teacher material; published examples and exercises are not imported. Tags are publisher estimates, not official JLPT inventories.

points.formation: Event noun or dictionary verb + に際して/に際し. Attributive に際しての + noun; polite connector に際しまして.
points.teachingChoice: Significant occasion and corresponding action/instruction, such as relocation or issuing a card. A whole sentence may report a past event; direct verb attachment remains dictionary form. Distinguish Nの際に from Nに際して, and do not insert の into the latter.
points.sourceCaution: The MLC explanation and worksheet explicitly allow overlap with にあたって. No scored question rejects the overlapping marker solely on a fine nuance. Failed JLPT Sensei URLs are not counted as inspected.

points.form: にあたって / にあたり
points.formation: Event noun or dictionary verb + にあたって/にあたり; written 当たって/当たり are available.
points.teachingChoice: Preparations, measures and intentions on undertaking something significant. Original facility-opening and event examples avoid turning every routine action into a formal milestone. Formation question supplies the requested pattern rather than forcing a false binary between the two occasion markers.
points.sourceCaution: The short Bunpro URL using に当たって was inaccessible; the combined にあたり-にあたって page was actually inspected.

points.formation: Noun + に限らず, expanding scope beyond that case; further included cases often take も.
points.teachingChoice: A workshop includes people beyond students while retaining booking, capacity and required-item rules. Read inclusion in its actual scope; do not infer unrestricted entry or automatic publication.
points.sourceCaution: JPF labels its older material 旧2級. That is historical categorisation, not an official current N2 mapping; formation and explanation are checked independently of the label.

points.form: に限って and formal restriction に限り
points.formation: Noun + に限って; time clauses may modify 日/とき. Formal noun + に限り marks a specified restriction.
points.teachingChoice: Examples distinguish a real opening-day restriction, an annoying one-off coincidence, and trusted-person disbelief. The spoken scene's forgotten items do not prove a habitual behaviour. The reading explicitly distinguishes workshop-room access from the building's hours.
points.sourceCaution: JPF treats formal に限り separately from coincidence/trust uses of に限って. に限る meaning the best choice is noted as separate; it is not scored as an interchangeable notice marker.

editorialReview.sceneChoice: Two twelve-line scenes: Yamamoto and Bao edit a practical relocation announcement; Misaki and Bao read a workshop poster and ask about borrowing with a forgotten card. Formal markers appear where a notice or considered explanation warrants them; peer chat stays ordinary.
editorialReview.wordChecks: Forty-four unused restricted-JMdict spelling/reading pairs. Examples distinguish 改定 of rules/prices from 改訂 of a publication; eligibility and formal administrative vocabulary remain supplementary study, not a spoken quota.
editorialReview.tasks: Twenty questions with one defensible answer each, explicit form-practice labels and reply listeners. First meet list includes 移転 and 注意事項 before their first scored use.
editorialReview.fixesBeforeRender: Removed absent 校正 from a standalone reply reference list. Removed the overtly formal 気遣い line from peer pen-lending chat. Notice thanks are directed to volunteers preparing the guidance, not implausible public draft-review acknowledgements. Contextual glosses occur in their own text. A documented 27 percent recycling target prioritises the actual notice/scene domain over vocabulary padding.
editorialReview.remaining: N2 whole-core review after unit 16 and independent native language/listening review.
